title: resultFiles
responsibility: Find historical result.json files only within bounded results collections, leaving logs and worktrees unread.

inputs.name: resultFiles.root
inputs.description: Historical results root; only results-* collection directories are traversed to a bounded depth. Filesystem errors at the collection boundary propagate.

outputs.name: resultFiles
outputs.description: Sorted paths to result.json files beneath results-* collections, without following directory symlinks.

errors.name: FileSystemError
errors.description: Unreadable results directories abort traversal; symlinks are not followed.
